rules: global-ever-open and current-only branch models both provisional; exact paired comparisons only on joint pass-consistent support

discovery.selection: latest eligible state per seed; focal >=2 current-only actions; both opponents <=3 tiles; hidden-seat prior no-stock pass; exact support <= cap
discovery.generationPolicies: seed-even=min-hand-pips; seed-odd=fast-doubles; seeded uniform top-ranked choice

conditioning.method: exact labeled allocation enumeration; reconstruct pass-time hand from current hand plus same-seat later public plays; filter both pass masks; paired set is intersection
conditioning.continuationSeed: mixSeed32(fnv1a(state-signature + # + allocation-fingerprint) XOR 0x6d2b79f5), shared across arms
conditioning.continuationPolicy: same action-orbit chooser across candidate arms; model-specific legal actions; salt 11
